description: Gets a B2B SaaS vendor's app listed on the HubSpot Marketplace and keeps it there - the three-active-install gate, the 25-install cap on unlisted apps, apps HubSpot refuses, scopes and the Shared data table, Draft bounces, review timelines, version deadlines, AI connector and MCP rules, App Certification, Technology Partner tiers. Use whenever a vendor mentions listing or certifying its app on HubSpot, a listing sent back to Draft, or HubSpot technology partner tiers. Do NOT use for listing copy or install conversion (use samber/developer-platform-skills@integration-listing-optimization), for running your own marketplace (use samber/developer-platform-skills@app-marketplace-review), for CMS themes, for admins vetting another vendor's app, or for CRM admin, API code or agency work.
